Name: 7Pay
HQ Location: Croatia, City Of Zagreb, Zagreb, 2 Koledovčina, 10000
Company description: 7 PAYMENTS is a payment technology company that specializes in developing and providing payment software solutions. We have a rich history dating back 20 years, when we first began developing our on-premises Payment Gateway system as a part of Sedam IT, our parent company. Over the years, we have acquired many notable clients, which prompted us to establish 7 PAYMENTS as a spin-off company. Our core software products include a payment gateway, front-end authorization system, back-end clearing and settlement system, merchant portal, secure application management system, key and terminal management systems, and mobile payment applications for Android SmartPOS and TapToMobile solution (SoftPOS). Our team is composed of experienced professionals from the fintech industry. In addition to payment industry expertise, our developers place a strong emphasis on quality assurance, certifications, commercial partnerships, and organizational activities. We are dedicated to providing the best service and support for our clients. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to reach out to us. We are always happy to help.

Name: Bitcoin Store
Company description: Bitcoin Store is a brand founded by the company Digital Assets d.o.o. Our story began in 2017 when we introduced a unique concept to the cryptocurrency market - a fusion of an online cryptocurrency platform with the accessibility and convenience of walk-in stores. This innovation was our way of making it easier for everyone to trade and invest in cryptocurrencies. Since then, the Bitcoin Store has expanded its suite of products with ◾ a digital wallet,  ◾ mobile application,  ◾ payment processor,  ◾ and six walk-in cryptocurrency exchanges. As a leading fintech platform in Croatia today, we are dedicated to upholding the highest security standards and complying with EU regulations, a commitment that has garnered the trust of thousands of individuals and businesses alike. Since day one, we have committed to pushing forward and building tools that will give every user more financial freedom in the era of the digital economy.

Name: Prolaz
Company description: Prolaz is a B2B FinTech company that helps banks and retailers capture the savings potential of multi-payment acceptance. Our PCI-DSS certified gateway intelligently routes transactions in real time, enabling retailers to reduce processing fees while helping banks access volumes they might not otherwise acquire with lower operating costs. With direct connections to local acquirers, instant payment and wallet providers across Europe, Prolaz makes payment acceptance smarter, faster, and at lower costs. We are redefining the economics of payment processing by putting local infrastructure and payment choice to work.
